name: trace_id
description: W3C 32-hex trace identifier of the content-bearing turn.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Owning application ID of the trace (NULL when unregistered).

name: previous_interaction_id
description: bq_eval.previous_interaction_id marking stateful delta turns (leaves prior_history NULL).

name: prior_history
description: Turns 1..k-1 message array as JSON (NULL on stateful delta turns or when absent, distinct from empty []).

name: turn_prompt
description: Last input message before the first model output of the turn, with its role, as JSON.

name: turn_context
description: Ordered JSON array of tool, retrieval, and memory results in the turn tagged with span_id, tool_name, operation_name, and tools flags.

name: turn_output
description: Arguments of the last sends_external_reply tool call, else the last root-agent model output requesting no tool, as JSON.

name: step_outputs
description: Ordered JSON array of per-step structured outputs keyed by span_id and optional nudge_id.

name: media_uris
description: JSON array of in-place storage URI objects carrying uri, document_bytes, page_count, and attachment_sha256.

name: system_instructions
description: Inline system instructions from the first root-agent model call as JSON (NULL in Shape 3 or when absent).

name: system_instructions_ref
description: Shape-3 gen_ai.system_instructions_ref address (kept as an address without BigLake dereferencing).

name: tool_definitions
description: Inline tool definitions from the first root-agent model call as JSON (NULL in Shape 3 or when absent).

name: tool_definitions_ref
description: Shape-3 gen_ai.tool.definitions_ref address (kept as an address without BigLake dereferencing).

name: prior_history_read_whole
description: TRUE when inline or Shape-3 input ref resolved completely; FALSE on missing ref; NULL when prior_history is NULL.

name: turn_prompt_read_whole
description: TRUE when inline or Shape-3 input ref resolved completely; FALSE on missing ref; NULL when turn_prompt is NULL.

name: turn_context_read_whole
description: TRUE when all context-contributing calls resolved completely; FALSE on any missing ref; NULL when turn_context is NULL.

name: turn_output_read_whole
description: TRUE when inline or Shape-3 output ref resolved completely; FALSE on missing ref; NULL when turn_output is NULL.

name: step_outputs_read_whole
description: TRUE when all step output refs resolved completely; FALSE on any missing ref; NULL when step_outputs is NULL.
